install: node24 -e 'const fs = require("node:fs"); const aliases = { NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL: "DATABASE_URL", NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL: "DATABASE_URL", NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST: "SMTP_HOST", NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PORT: "SMTP_PORT", NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_NAME: "SMTP_FROM_NAME", NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS: "SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS" }; const settings = Object.entries(aliases).map(([target, source]) => { const value = process.env[target] ?? process.env[source]; if (!value) { throw new Error(`Missing environment variable: ${source}`); } return `${target}=${JSON.stringify(value)}`; }); fs.writeFileSync(".env.local", settings.join("\n") + "\n", { mode: 0o600 });'

web.cmd: timeout 180 sh -c 'until docker compose -f docker/development/compose.yml exec -T database pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U documenso -d documenso -q; do sleep 1; done' && npm24 run prisma:migrate-deploy && exec npm24 run dev -w @documenso/remix -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT"
